name: Ammiel
overview: Ammiel is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Machir. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details beyond this familial connection. His mention is brief and focused on his role within his family lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Ammiel means 'G-d [El] is my kinsman,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that emphasizes God's relational closeness. This proper name is noted in 2 Samuel 9:4 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Ammiel as the father of Machir, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family relationships are recorded in the biblical text concerning Ammiel.
scriptureSignificance: Ammiel's significance in the biblical narrative stems from his role as the father of Machir, linking him to the lineage mentioned in 2 Samuel 9. Though details about Ammiel himself are sparse, his mention helps trace the genealogy and connections important to the unfolding story in the Old Testament. His name's meaning also subtly underscores the theme of God's kinship with His people.
